description: This file defines the MBPackage class, which manages module packages in SuiteCRM, including loading modules, generating manifests, creating install scripts, exporting packages, and handling relationships. It is a core part of the module packaging system.

classes.name: MBPackage
classes.description: Represents a module package in SuiteCRM, providing functionalities to load, save, delete, export, and manipulate modules and their relationships within the package.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an MBPackage object with the given package name and loads its data.

methods.name: loadModules
methods.description: Loads modules from the package directory.

methods.name: loadModuleTitles
methods.description: Loads translated titles for the modules from specified language files.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an MBModule object for a given module name.

methods.name: getModuleByFullName
methods.description: Returns an MBModule instance based on its full package-specific name.

methods.name: deleteModule
methods.description: Deletes a module from the package.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Generates the package manifest array, optionally version-specific or for export.

methods.name: buildInstall
methods.description: Creates the installation definitions array for package deployment.

methods.name: getPackageDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path of the package.

methods.name: getBuildDir
methods.description: Returns the build directory path for the package.

methods.name: getZipDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for package zip files.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads package metadata and modules from the manifest file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves package manifest and module metadata.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the package, generates ZIP archive, and optionally exports it.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Provides a nested node structure representing the package and its modules.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates package data from POST request parameters.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames the package directory.

methods.name: updateModulesMetaData
methods.description: Updates metadata for all modules within the package.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the package with a new name.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the package directory.

methods.name: customBuildInstall
methods.description: Creates installation definitions for customizations export.

methods.name: getLanguageManifestForModule
methods.description: Builds language files manifest for a module.

methods.name: getCustomFieldsManifestForModule
methods.description: Creates custom fields manifest definitions.

methods.name: getCustomMetadataManifestForModule
methods.description: Creates metadata files manifest.

methods.name: getExtensionsManifestForPackage
methods.description: Generates extension module files for the package.

methods.name: getColumnsName
methods.description: Returns list of column names for custom fields meta data.

methods.name: exportCustom
methods.description: Exports custom modules as a package ZIP.

methods.name: convertLangFilesToExtensions
methods.description: Converts language files into extension format.

methods.name: copyCustomDropdownValuesForModules
methods.description: Copies custom dropdown values for modules into build directory.

methods.name: getCustomDropDownStringsForModules
methods.description: Retrieves dropdown options for modules.

methods.name: getCustomModules
methods.description: Lists custom modules, or specific module if parameter provided.

methods.name: getExtensionsList
methods.description: Retrieves list of extension files for a module.

methods.name: filterExportedRelationshipFile
methods.description: Determines if a relationship file should be included in export based on module names.

methods.name: getRelationshipsForModule
methods.description: Returns relationship definitions associated with a specific module.

methods.name: exportProjectInstall
methods.description: Generates installation array for project export.

methods.name: exportProject
methods.description: Creates a project ZIP archive for export.

methods.name: getCustomRelationshipsByModuleName
methods.description: Fetches all custom relationships for a module.

methods.name: getCustomRelationshipsMetaFilesByModuleName
methods.description: Retrieves relationship metadata files for a module.

methods.name: deleteBuild
methods.description: Removes the build directory.
